name: Bitter eggplant
summary: Purple bitter eggplant from Ba Na villages, grilled whole over charcoal or cooked into a soup with pork. It starts slightly bitter and leaves a sweet aftertaste.
origin: A Ba Na village vegetable around Kon Tum.
taste: Slightly bitter, with a sweet aftertaste.
howToEat: Eat it grilled whole over charcoal, or as a soup with pork.
where: Ba Na villages around Kon Tum.
seoTitle: Bitter eggplant in Kon Tum — grilled or in soup
seoDescription: Ba Na purple bitter eggplant, grilled whole over charcoal or cooked with pork, slightly bitter with a sweet aftertaste.
